metadata.title: On the Capacity of the 2-user Gaussian MAC Interfering with a P2P Link

extraction_notes.note: Numbered equation (38) kept as a claim rather than an equation: the text presents it as the treating-interference-as-noise sum capacity lower bound, justified by the preceding sentence (PP8).
Claim or remark: a one-sentence fragment asserting that the analogue of Theorem 3 holds for transmitter 2, with no argument; kept as a semi-formal claim.
The interference-regime conditions of Sections 4.1-4.3 are introduced by 'Consider'/'Suppose'; those naming a regime were made definitions, the unnamed 'Suppose that the PIMAC has' one an assumption.

Proofs of Theorems 3-5 are argued in running text before each theorem; each proof node spans from the first argumentative sentence to the 'we obtain the following theorem' sentence, excluding the regime-setting sentences and the informal restatement of Theorem 5.

The paper mixes the notations $\mathcal{C}^M$ and $\mathcal{C}_M$ for the same MAC region, and the appendix text says $M(\{2,3\},2)$ where $\mathcal{C}^M(\{1,3\},2)$ is meant; statements copied as written.

Introduction restatements of the results and the cited IC capacity results (Carleial, Sato, noisy-interference sum capacity) are only mentioned, not stated, so they get no nodes; figure-only content (capacity region plots) is not extracted.
